{{Quote|One to Two. I’m to starboard.''"<br />"''Rage Two, aye.|Voort saBinring to Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Rage Two''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Myri Antilles]] as part of [[Team Rage]] during [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. Wraith Squadron was a Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit disbanded by then [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], but secretly reformed by [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Garik Loran]].<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> Antilles and [[Voort saBinring]], who used the [[Rage One]] call sign, were tasked with flying their [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and strafing the launching pad of [[Chakham Army Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. The base served as the headquarters of the elite Alliance army unit the [[Pop-Dogs]], which was founded and led by Thaal. The pair's objective was to destroy as many [[E-wing starfighter|E-wings]] as possible.<ref name="MK" /> 

Their next step was to fly up to [[Skifter Station]] and initiate a skirmish against the Pop-Dogs to get the attention of [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]], forcing it to send units down to the planet in order to act as witnesses to the evidence against Thaal and subsequently arresting him.<ref name="MK" />
